page.layout: One page of text, English; ornamental border at top; a dated line in italic; body paragraph with large woodcut initial; signature lines at the foot; catchword at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: ORdered by the Lords Assembled, that none shall print the Booke Entituled ( Expositio Analytica omnium Apostolicarum Epistolarum seu brevis introductio ad pleniores commentarios in usum studiosorum Theologiae, opera à Davidis Dicsoni in Academia Glasguensi Theologiae professoris) without a speciall Licence from the Author under his hand and writing.

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an O, joined to "Rdered" as "ORdered". The first line is set in capitals of a decorative border above. The dated line is italic with lining figures "24" and "1646" in roman. Catchword "Episto-" is at lower right, with the hyphen as printed. Signature "A 2" at lower left. The text "Jo: Browne Cler." and "Parliamentorum." are set in italic, right of centre, and are not headings.
